summary: Thx for the recommendation @dogtrax https://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/content/listen/ I listen too Kamasi a new ear stumbling on sounds of a future's past an ethnomusicology unfolding in a dancing Lotus peaking from behind the curtain #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Thx for the recommendation @dogtrax https://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/content/listen/

I listen too
Kamasi
a new ear
stumbling on
sounds
of a future's
past
an
ethnomusicology
unfolding in a
dancing
Lotus
peaking from
behind the
curtain
#smallpoems
